title: flt.c_bpf~
description: `flt.c_bpf~` calculates the five biquad coefficients (`b0`, `b1`, `b2`, `a1`, and `a2`) for a band-pass filter, intended for use with an object such as `flt.biquad~`. It accepts a control signal and lets you set the center frequency in Hz and the quality factor Q, where Q is defined as frequency divided by bandwidth.
